status = general progress; subject = resolved entity; agent = checker state/step; cards = intermediate findings; result = completed result; error = failure; end = stream closure. CheckRun holds events and an asyncio.Condition so readers can wait for new output.|||status = general progress; subject = resolved entity; agent = checker state/step; cards = intermediate findings; result = complete result; error = failure; end = stream close. title: Backend orchestration|||Backend orchestration
lead: asyncio overlaps network waits; it does not magically multiply CPU speed.|||asyncio network wait overlap karta hai; CPU speed magically multiply nahi hoti.

The main checker deadline defaults to 55 seconds. Individual checker wrappers use CHECK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS + 30. Resolver and other processing can make total duration longer. Cache replay emits an existing result. fresh=True collects again. Human-assist recomputes after recording submitted evidence as a new revision. Skipped means not applicable; unverified/error means the source did not establish a usable answer.|||Cache replay existing result bhejta hai. fresh=True dobara collect karta hai. title: Resolve the correct target|||Sahi target resolve karo

resolver.py recognizes URLs, app-store links and messaging links. signals.py classifies input/category and checks local trusted-domain/impersonation cues. App lookup India ke Apple iTunes software search aur Google Play pages use karta hai. Search match candidate hai, verified business ownership nahi.

A real platform does not automatically verify every user page hosted on it.|||linkintel.py parsed host, registrable domain, public-suffix aur local brand/identity records use karta hai. title: AI and grounding|||AI aur grounding
lead: Deterministic scoring does not guarantee correct facts: AI may influence the extracted inputs to the rules.|||Deterministic scoring correct facts ki guarantee nahi: AI rules ke extracted inputs influence kar sakta hai.
sections: How Gemini is used|||Gemini ka role

gemini.py calls generateContent with requested search/URL-context tools, parses structured output, and retains returned sources and queries. Model name is environment-configured; code default is gemini-flash-lite-latest with fallback candidates. The launcher disables AI_SUMMARY, so final explanations normally use templates.|||gemini.py requested search/URL-context tools ke saath generateContent call, structured output parse aur sources/queries save karta hai. Model environment-configured hai; code default gemini-flash-lite-latest aur fallbacks hain. Launcher AI_SUMMARY off rakhta hai, isliye final explanation normally template se hoti hai.
Rate-limit caveat you must know|||Rate-limit caveat zaroor jaano

Current code removes attached tools after HTTP 429 before retrying. Never claim every answer is search-grounded. RBI/SEBI reject no-source findings; company/news apply extra source checks, but these are not complete fact verification. A model can return incorrect or stale information even with links.|||Current code HTTP 429 par tools hata kar retry karta hai. Har answer search-grounded bolna galat hai. RBI/SEBI no-source findings reject karte hain; company/news extra source checks karte hain, par yeh complete fact verification nahi. Links ke saath bhi model wrong/stale information de sakta hai.
Hallucination and injection defenses|||Hallucination aur injection defenses

Evidence extraction, source checks and fixed rules reduce unconstrained AI decisions. They do not eliminate malicious page instructions or bad entity matching. Production needs stricter fallback behavior, claim-level citations and adversarial evaluation; do not claim prompt-injection immunity.|||Evidence extraction, source checks aur fixed rules AI ke unrestricted decisions kam karte hain. Malicious page instructions ya wrong entity matching khatam nahi hote. Production mein strict fallback, claim-level citations aur adversarial evaluation chahiye; prompt-injection immunity claim mat karo.

title: Safe public-page fetching|||Public page ko safely fetch karna
lead: The scanner must not become a route into private networks. This is the purpose of the SSRF boundary.|||Scanner private networks mein entry ka rasta na ban jaye; isi liye SSRF boundary hai.
sections: What SSRF means|||SSRF ka matlab

Server-Side Request Forgery means an attacker supplies a URL that makes your server request an internal service, such as localhost or a cloud metadata address. web.py rejects private, loopback, link-local and reserved addresses, URL credentials, unusual ports and ambiguous URL syntax.|||SSRF mein attacker aisa URL deta hai jisse aapka server localhost ya cloud metadata jaise internal service ko request bhej de. web.py private, loopback, link-local/reserved IPs, URL credentials, unusual ports aur ambiguous syntax reject karta hai.
Network controls|||Network controls

The direct fetcher validates redirect destinations, limits redirects to 5 and response bytes to 5 MB, and uses validated address pinning in the normal transport path. Pinning helps address DNS rebinding: validating one IP and accidentally connecting to a changed private IP. These controls still need production egress defense in depth.|||Direct fetcher redirect destination validate, maximum 5 redirects aur 5 MB response limit karta hai. Normal transport mein validated address pinning hoti hai. Isse DNS rebinding risk kam hota hai: validate public IP aur connect private IP ho jana. Production mein network egress defense bhi chahiye.
Browser ladder status|||Browser ladder ki reality

Fallback code contains curl_cffi, nodriver and Playwright, plus TLS/DNS inspection. The launcher sets active browser inspection and screenshots to false. A blocked page can remain unavailable; this is not proof of fraud. Do not pitch guaranteed CAPTCHA bypass.|||Fallback code mein curl_cffi, nodriver, Playwright aur TLS/DNS inspection hain. Launcher active browser aur screenshots false rakhta hai. Blocked page unavailable reh sakta hai; yeh fraud proof nahi. Guaranteed CAPTCHA bypass pitch mat karo.

title: Deep public-surface inspection|||Deep public-surface inspection
lead: Deep means several relevant public surfaces with explicit coverage, not access to hidden backend code.|||Deep ka matlab relevant public surfaces aur clear coverage; hidden backend code ka access nahi.
sections: Crawl policy|||Crawl policy

investigate() parses links from the root and chooses same-netloc informational paths such as about, contact, privacy, refund, download and payments. It strips fragments, rejects query-bearing candidates and excludes action paths such as logout, buy and submit. It does not recursively crawl the entire internet.|||investigate() root ke links parse karke same-netloc about, contact, privacy, refund, download/payments jaise paths choose karta hai. Fragments remove, query-bearing candidates reject aur logout/buy/submit paths exclude hote hain. Poora internet recursively crawl nahi hota.
Bounds and evidence|||Limits aur evidence

Maximum coverage is root + 3 pages. Extra fetches run concurrently with a 7-second wrapper each, using the existing safe fetcher. Each readable page gets an evidence ID, raw HTML capture up to 2 MB, final URL and redirect trace. Merged risk rules are deduplicated by rule ID.|||Maximum root + 3 pages hain. Extra fetches concurrent, har ek ka 7-second wrapper aur existing safe fetcher hai. Readable page ko evidence ID, up to 2 MB HTML capture, final URL aur redirect trace milta hai. Merged risks rule ID se deduplicate hote hain.
What is not followed|||Kya follow nahi hota

Discovered external scripts, installer URLs and HTML meta-refresh targets are recorded as references; they are not all executed or independently fetched. Coverage says pages read versus attempted. Root-page failure means deep inspection cannot be claimed.|||External scripts, installer URLs aur HTML meta-refresh targets references ki tarah record hote hain; sab execute/independently fetch nahi hote. Coverage pages read aur attempted dikhati hai. Root fail ho toh deep inspection claim nahi kar sakte.

title: Payments: evidence, not assumptions|||Payments: evidence, assumptions nahi
lead: A request for bank details or a UPI payment can be legitimate. The destination and context matter.|||Bank details ya UPI payment request genuine ho sakti hai. Destination aur context matter karte hain.

checkout.razorpay.com is different from checkout.razorpay.com.evil.example. The code parses the hostname instead of trusting copied text or a gateway logo. Exact known HTTPS endpoint, with valid URL structure. Merchant identity and transaction outcome are not verified.|||Exact known HTTPS endpoint aur valid URL structure. Merchant identity/transaction outcome verified nahi.
Unencrypted submission may expose account/credential data.|||Unencrypted submission account/credential data expose kar sakti hai.

Different registrable domain without recognized gateway; affiliation needs checking. Could still be a legitimate integration.|||Different registrable domain, recognized gateway nahi; affiliation check chahiye. Legitimate integration bhi ho sakta hai.
Entered values can appear in URLs, history and logs.|||Entered values URL, history aur logs mein aa sakti hain.
Recorded as context; the new page-surface analyzer does not automatically penalize these alone.|||Context mein record; new page-surface analyzer inhe akela automatically penalize nahi karta.

title: Apps, downloads and threat sources|||Apps, downloads aur threat sources
lead: Separate listing metadata, download-link observations and malware reputation; they answer different questions.|||Listing metadata, download-link observations aur malware reputation alag rakho; inke questions alag hain.

Apple iTunes search provides candidate app metadata. Google Play lookup/search and listing pages provide publisher and data-safety text. These observations do not prove malware execution or identify the author.|||Surface parser APK/XAPK/APKS/IPA/EXE/MSI/DMG/mobileconfig links aur hosts list karta hai. Script/iframe sources, refresh targets, selected encoded-JavaScript patterns aur adult/betting terms bhi record hote hain. Yeh malware execution ya author identity prove nahi karte.
Passive intelligence|||Passive intelligence

passive.py gathers phishing/malware feeds, Tranco rank, optional Google Safe Browsing/VirusTotal, certificate-transparency and prior urlscan observations, plus a lexical heuristic. No API key, no hit or no result is not a clean malware certificate. Popularity and HTTPS are not safety guarantees.|||passive.py phishing/malware feeds, Tranco rank, optional Safe Browsing/VirusTotal, certificate-transparency, prior urlscan observations aur lexical heuristic use karta hai. Key na ho, hit na ho ya result na mile toh clean malware certificate nahi. Popularity/HTTPS safety guarantee nahi.

Poore engine ke false positives eliminate ho gaye, yeh mat bolo.

title: ProofGrid scoring and confidence|||ProofGrid scoring aur confidence
lead: The score is a rule-based index, not a calibrated probability of fraud.|||Score rule-based index hai; calibrated fraud probability nahi.
sections: How the number is calculated|||Number kaise banta hai

Base arithmetic: score = max(0, 100 - sum of applied penalties). Each Hit records rule_id, agent, penalty, claim, how_checked, found and evidence_ids. UNKNOWN is a deliberate exception to presenting the raw number as trust: its internal value is neutral, not a safety score.|||Base formula: score = max(0, 100 - applied penalties ka sum). Har Hit rule_id, agent, penalty, claim, how_checked, found aur evidence_ids rakhta hai. UNKNOWN mein raw number trust ki tarah present nahi hota; internal value neutral hai, safety score nahi.
Confidence is a separate heuristic|||Confidence alag heuristic hai

Seven evidence areas produce pass/warn/fail/unknown rows. The count called verified means rows with evidence, not necessarily successful checks. HIGH confidence can come from recognized official identity or a strong negative signal. It is not statistical certainty and can coexist with incomplete page coverage.|||Seven areas pass/warn/fail/unknown rows banate hain. verified count ka matlab evidence wali rows hai, zaroori nahi successful checks. HIGH confidence official identity ya strong negative signal se aa sakti hai. Yeh statistical certainty nahi aur partial coverage ke saath bhi ho sakti hai.

title: Evidence: capture, seal, revise|||Evidence: capture, seal, revise
lead: An evidence ID connects a finding to the retained material used to support it.|||Evidence ID finding ko uske supporting saved material se connect karti hai.

EvidenceStore records ID, agent, kind, label, source URL, captured_at, SHA-256, filename and simulated flag. What a revision adds|||Revision kya add karti hai

provenance.py freezes a result snapshot, manifest and artifact descriptors; builds a typed dependency graph; records changed evidence/rules; links previous_revision_hash; and writes a new directory using locking and exclusive writes. Human-assist creates another revision instead of silently rewriting history.|||provenance.py result snapshot, manifest/artifact descriptors freeze, typed dependency graph aur changed evidence/rules record karta hai. previous_revision_hash link aur locking/exclusive writes se new directory banti hai. title: Merkle tree and commitment|||Merkle tree aur commitment
lead: A Merkle tree summarizes many evidence descriptors into one root hash. A salted commitment then binds the larger bundle.|||Merkle tree multiple evidence descriptors ko ek root hash mein summarize karta hai. Salted commitment larger bundle ko bind karta hai.
sections: Exact implementation|||Exact implementation

Canonical JSON uses UTF-8, sorted string keys, compact separators and rejected NaN/infinity. This is python-json-v1, not a claim of RFC 8785 compatibility. Artifact digests bind metadata and bytes. Ordered leaf/node hashing uses distinct domain prefixes; an odd level duplicates the last node.|||Canonical JSON UTF-8, sorted string keys, compact separators aur NaN/infinity rejection use karta hai. Yeh python-json-v1 hai, RFC 8785 compatibility claim nahi. Artifact digest metadata aur bytes bind karta hai. Ordered leaf/node hashing ke alag domain prefixes hain; odd level last node duplicate karta hai.
Why the salt matters|||Salt kyun important hai

Each revision generates 32 random bytes of salt. commitment = SHA256(COMMIT_DOMAIN || salt || ASCII(bundle_sha256)). The unsigned on-chain payload contains this commitment, not the evidence or salt. The private offline revision/bundle contains material needed to verify it. A shared bundle therefore needs careful access control.|||Har revision 32 random bytes salt banati hai. commitment = SHA256(COMMIT_DOMAIN || salt || ASCII(bundle_sha256)). Unsigned chain payload mein commitment hota hai, evidence/salt nahi. Private offline revision/bundle verification ka material rakhta hai; shared bundle ko access control chahiye.

Pair and combine::Odd last node duplicated
callout: The value prepared for anchoring is the salted bundle commitment, not simply the raw Merkle root.|||Anchoring ke liye salted bundle commitment prepare hota hai, sirf raw Merkle root nahi.

The selector uses Ethereum Keccak-256, not NIST SHA3-256.|||POST anchor/prepare consent, nonzero 32-byte commitment, positive chain ID aur nonzero 20-byte address validate karta hai. chainId, to, data, value=0x0 return hote hain. data = selector 0x54be8d59 + 32-byte commitment. broadcast_enabled is always false. There is no wallet, signer, RPC sender, gas estimator or receipt-verification path in this helper. Configured chain ID 11155111 targets Sepolia in a future workflow; the configured contract address is not evidence of deployment. Prepared/simulated is not anchored.|||broadcast_enabled hamesha false hai. Helper mein wallet, signer, RPC sender, gas estimator ya receipt-verification path nahi. Chain ID 11155111 future Sepolia workflow target karta hai; configured address deployment proof nahi. Prepared/simulated ka matlab anchored nahi.
What anchoring could prove later|||Baad mein anchor kya prove karega

A verified transaction can establish that a publisher submitted a commitment by a chain timestamp. It still cannot establish that a page was truthful, that its operator is guilty, or that a report is automatically admissible in court.|||Verified transaction publisher ka commitment chain timestamp tak submit hona establish kar sakta hai. title: Security, authentication and privacy|||Security, authentication aur privacy
lead: Local development behavior and production protections are different configurations.|||Local development aur production protections alag configurations hain.
sections: Application boundary|||Application boundary

security.py checks origin, request sizes, rate limits and resource access. Production requires HTTPS origin, a sufficiently long session secret and project configuration; missing configuration fails closed. Signed session handling, OAuth state/nonce and ownership records support authenticated isolation. The local launcher intentionally uses development mode.|||security.py origin, request size, rate limit aur resource access check karta hai. Production ko HTTPS origin, long session secret aur project config chahiye; missing config par fail-closed. Signed sessions, OAuth state/nonce aur ownership records isolation support karte hain. Local launcher development mode use karta hai.
Privacy is best effort|||Privacy best effort hai

Human-submitted text is minimized with regexes for emails, phone numbers and 12-digit identifiers. This is not guaranteed anonymization. Public captures, queries and evidence can contain personal data. Downloaded bundles may include sensitive original material and salts; treat them as private.|||Human-submitted text mein email, phone aur 12-digit identifiers regex se minimize hote hain. Guaranteed anonymization nahi. Public captures, queries aur evidence mein personal data ho sakta hai. Downloaded bundle mein sensitive original material/salt ho sakta hai; private treat karo.
What production still needs|||Production ko aur kya chahiye

Formal retention/deletion policy, encryption and key management, network egress isolation, authorization review, centralized rate limits, monitoring and adversarial tests. Do not expose the development server publicly. Never show settings.env/backend .env, cookies or API keys during a demo.|||Retention/deletion policy, encryption/key management, network egress isolation, authorization review, centralized rate limits, monitoring aur adversarial tests chahiye. Development server public expose mat karo. Demo mein settings.env/backend .env, cookies ya API keys mat dikhana.

Demo reports are explicitly labelled simulated.|||PDF readable report hai: deductions, investigation aur evidence excerpts. TXT portable text report hai. Investigation.tsx allows local text edits and copying. Those edits are not automatically saved to downloaded reports. A review checkbox gates official portal links in this panel; simulated reports do not get submission links there. The app does not authenticate to or submit into the government portal.|||Investigation.tsx local draft edit/copy deta hai. Edits automatically downloaded reports mein save nahi hote. Review checkbox is panel ke official portal links gate karta hai; simulated reports ko wahan submission links nahi milte. App government portal mein authenticate/submit nahi karta.

When inspection fails, a consenting user can paste observations. The backend minimizes text, saves user-asserted evidence, extracts claims, recomputes and creates a revision. For financial loss, official guidance directs victims to 1930 or the cybercrime portal.|||Inspection fail ho toh consent se user observations paste kar sakta hai. The final backend run recorded 163 passed, 1 skipped. Production Next.js build and TypeScript passed. Desktop/mobile browser checks covered draft editing, demo submission guard and no JavaScript errors.|||Final backend run: 163 passed, 1 skipped. Production Next.js build/TypeScript pass. Running-app smoke mein unsafe form, fake gateway rejection, installer inventory, PDF/TXT, ZIP aur evidence verify hue. title: Judge Q&A: architecture|||Judge Q&A: architecture
lead: Answer in one clear sentence, then offer the deeper explanation.|||Pehle ek clear sentence, phir deeper explanation.
sections: Q: Are these really five AI agents?|||Q: Kya five AI agents hain?

They are five specialized async checker modules coordinated by Python. Some use Gemini search-assisted extraction; others use HTTP parsing and RDAP. We do not claim five independent self-governing LLM services.|||Yeh Python-coordinated five specialized async checker modules hain. Kuch Gemini search-assisted extraction use karte hain; kuch HTTP parsing/RDAP. Five independent self-governing LLM services ka claim nahi.
Q: Why FastAPI and Next.js?|||Q: FastAPI aur Next.js kyun?

FastAPI provides validated Python endpoints and async I/O around existing investigation code. Next.js/React provides routed pages and reactive streaming UI, with an API proxy. These choices separate presentation from backend decisions.|||FastAPI validated Python endpoints aur investigation code ke around async I/O deta hai. Next.js/React routed pages, reactive streaming UI aur API proxy deta hai. Presentation aur backend decisions separate rehte hain.
Q: Why SQLite, and can it scale?|||Q: SQLite kyun, scale hoga?

SQLite makes the Windows demo portable without a database service. SQLAlchemy supports a PostgreSQL configuration later. Scaling also needs a shared worker queue, event store, cache and distributed limits; changing the DB alone is insufficient.|||SQLite Windows demo portable banata hai, alag database service nahi chahiye. SQLAlchemy se PostgreSQL configure ho sakta hai. Scaling ko shared worker queue, event store, cache/distributed limits bhi chahiye; DB change akela enough nahi.
Q: Is it entirely offline?|||Q: Kya poora offline hai?

No. Local lexical/registry rules, saved evidence verification and demo fixtures can run without external data. Fresh public pages, app stores, RDAP, AI and threat sources need network access. Offline does not mean fresh threat coverage.|||Nahi. Local lexical/registry rules, saved evidence verification aur demos external data ke bina chal sakte hain. Fresh pages, app stores, RDAP, AI/threat sources ko network chahiye. Offline ka matlab fresh threat coverage nahi.
Q: Does AI decide the score?|||Q: AI score decide karta hai?

No, fixed Python rules choose penalties. AI can still affect extracted facts or identity resolution, so source quality and validation remain important. Deterministic scoring is reproducibility, not automatic correctness.|||Nahi, fixed Python rules penalties choose karte hain. AI extracted facts/identity resolution affect kar sakta hai, isliye source quality aur validation important hain. Deterministic scoring reproducibility hai, automatic correctness nahi.

title: Judge Q&A: trust and coverage|||Judge Q&A: trust aur coverage
lead: Do not turn a useful signal into a stronger claim than the evidence supports.|||Useful signal ko evidence se bada claim mat banao.
sections: Q: How do you avoid flagging real banks?|||Q: Real bank ko scam kaise nahi bolte?

We distinguish official identity and context from the presence of financial fields. Ordinary UPI and contact forms are not sufficient in the new surface rules. However old lexical rules and identity heuristics still need false-positive benchmarking.|||Official identity/context ko financial fields ki presence se alag rakhte hain. New surface rules mein normal UPI/contact form enough nahi. Lekin old lexical rules/identity heuristics ko false-positive benchmark abhi chahiye.
Q: Can a scammer use real Razorpay or a store listing?|||Q: Scammer real gateway/store use kare toh?

Yes; a provider endpoint or store presence is not business certification. We display the observed reference and inspect other contradictions. We do not yet verify merchant onboarding or beneficiary ownership through provider APIs.|||Haan; provider endpoint/store presence business certification nahi. Reference show karke other contradictions inspect karte hain. Provider APIs se merchant onboarding/beneficiary ownership abhi verify nahi karte.
Q: Have you reverse-engineered the APK?|||Q: APK reverse-engineer kiya?

No. This build records download links and public app metadata. A separate isolated pipeline is needed for binary hashes, signing certificates, manifest permissions, static code analysis and sandboxed behavior. Never run an untrusted installer during the demo.|||Nahi. Is build mein download links aur public app metadata record hote hain. Binary hash, signing certificate, manifest permissions, static code aur sandbox behavior ke liye separate isolated pipeline chahiye. Demo mein untrusted installer run mat karo.
Q: How accurate is the detector?|||Q: Accuracy kitni hai?

We have regression and integration evidence, not a validated universal accuracy percentage. We plan labelled evaluation of precision, recall, false positives, UNKNOWN rate and latency, including legitimate small merchants.|||Regression/integration evidence hai, validated universal accuracy percentage nahi. Labelled evaluation mein precision, recall, false positives, UNKNOWN rate aur latency measure karenge; legitimate small merchants bhi include honge.
Q: Can you identify the scammer or inspect hidden code?|||Q: Scammer identify ya hidden code inspect kar sakte ho?

Public registration/hosting clues may help, but privacy-protected RDAP, shared hosting and redirects do not prove a person. Client HTML cannot reveal all server-side behavior. We provide investigative leads, not attribution certainty.|||Public registration/hosting clues help kar sakte hain, par private RDAP/shared hosting/redirects person prove nahi karte. Client HTML poora backend behavior nahi dikhata. Hum leads dete hain, attribution certainty nahi.

title: Judge Q&A: evidence and chain|||Judge Q&A: evidence aur chain
lead: This is where precise wording makes the product more credible.|||Yahan precise wording product ko credible banati hai.
sections: Q: Is the evidence tamper-proof?|||Q: Evidence tamper-proof hai?

It is tamper-evident relative to retained hashes and revision records. A changed byte breaks verification against an intact reference. Full local filesystem compromise can replace evidence and hashes together; independent anchoring or protected backups strengthen that boundary.|||Intact hashes/revision ke comparison mein tamper-evident hai. Byte change ho toh verification fail. Full local filesystem compromise evidence aur hashes dono replace kar sakta hai; independent anchoring/protected backup boundary strong karega.
Q: Is it live on Sepolia?|||Q: Sepolia par live hai?

No live broadcast is implemented. The code prepares a consented unsigned call and includes a Solidity contract source. We have not established deployment, transaction submission or a verified chain receipt for this bundle.|||Live broadcast implemented nahi. Code consent ke saath unsigned call prepare karta hai aur Solidity contract source hai. Is bundle ke liye deployment, transaction submission ya verified receipt establish nahi hui.
Q: Why blockchain rather than only a database?|||Q: Database ke badle blockchain kyun?

A future independently verified chain commitment could make later evidence replacement harder to conceal. The current value is already in the local evidence ledger and offline verification. Blockchain is an optional integrity extension, not the scam-detection engine.|||Future verified chain commitment se evidence replace karna chhupana mushkil ho sakta hai. Current value local ledger/offline verification mein already hai. Blockchain optional integrity extension hai, scam-detection engine nahi.
Q: Can police treat this as an FIR or legal proof?|||Q: Yeh FIR ya legal proof hai?

The app prepares a reviewable evidence package and complaint draft. The user submits through official channels. A hash does not automatically establish admissibility, truth, authorship or guilt, and a complaint acknowledgement is not automatically an FIR.|||App reviewable evidence package aur complaint draft banata hai. User official channels se submit karta hai. Hash automatically admissibility, truth, authorship ya guilt prove nahi karta; complaint acknowledgement automatically FIR nahi.
Q: What would you build next?|||Q: Next kya build karoge?

First benchmark and tune false positives; strengthen authoritative entity/merchant binding and AI grounding. Then isolate binary analysis and production egress/jobs. Add chain deployment/receipt verification only when an operational need and consent flow justify it.|||Pehle benchmark/false positives, authoritative entity/merchant binding aur AI grounding strong karenge. Phir isolated binary analysis aur production egress/jobs. Chain deployment/receipt verification tab jab operational need aur consent flow justify kare.
